stdlib.name: GHZ
stdlib.summary: H on the first wire, then a chain of CX: (|0...0> + |1...1>)/sqrt(2).

stdlib.name: W
stdlib.summary: One excitation spread evenly: X on the first wire, then for each next wire a controlled RY with cos(theta/2) = sqrt(1/(n-k+1)) and a CX back.

stdlib.name: Superdense
stdlib.summary: A 2-bit message (0b00 to 0b11) sent through a Bell pair.

stdlib.name: Teleport
stdlib.summary: Moves the state of the first wire to the third.

stdlib.name: Deutsch
stdlib.summary: Oracle "constant0", "constant1", "balanced" (f(x) = x, the default) or "balanced-inverted" (f(x) = not x).

stdlib.name: BV
stdlib.summary: Bernstein-Vazirani with a phase oracle (Z on each secret bit between two H layers).

stdlib.name: Grover
stdlib.summary: The argument is the marked state; the qubit count is its bit width.

stdlib.name: QFT
stdlib.summary: Quantum Fourier transform with the first wire as LSB: basis state x goes to the sum over k of e^(2 pi i x k / 2^n) |k> / sqrt(2^n).

stdlib.name: IQFT
stdlib.summary: The exact inverse of QFT on the same wires (reversed order, negated angles).

stdlib.name: Shor
stdlib.summary: Order finding for N = 15 (the only supported modulus), a in {2, 4, 7, 8, 11, 13, 14} (default 7), counting qubits default 3.

stdlib.name: PhaseKickback
stdlib.summary: kind is "CX" or "CZ"; anything else is an error.

stdlib.name: PhaseOracle
stdlib.summary: Flips the sign of the marked basis state (or each state in a list) and leaves the rest unchanged.

stdlib.name: SwapTest
stdlib.summary: An ancilla and two registers of equal size (3, 5, 7, ... wires).

stdlib.name: StatePreparation
stdlib.summary: Basis states (a bitstring or a list such as (0b101..0b111)) with their probabilities; whatever is left of 1 goes to |0...0>.

stdlib.name: QubitPreparation
stdlib.summary: RY(2 asin(sqrt(p))) on each wire, so P(|1>) = p per qubit.

stdlib.name: BitFlip
stdlib.summary: The 3-qubit bit-flip code: encode with two CX, apply X on code qubit error (0, 1, or 2; -1 or omitted for none), decode with two CX, and correct with CX [a1,a2,data].

stdlib.name: QPE
stdlib.summary: Phase estimation of P(angle) with counting qubits (default 3) and the target on the last wire, prepared in |1>.

stdlib.name: Stego
stdlib.summary: Hides a bitstring in the phases of a uniform superposition (H on every wire, Z on the secret bits): every outcome is equally likely.
